Passwordless authentication for web servers. No passwords. No sessions. Nothing to breach.

Every auth system today asks your server to hold a secret — a password hash, a session token, an API key. That secret is a liability. It gets breached. It gets phished. It gets rotated on a schedule that nobody follows.

Arken Auth flips the model: the user holds the secret, the server holds nothing.

hacker_news.title: Plane Is Somewhere Else
hacker_news.author: Southflow
hacker_news.summary: How I predict flight delays by tracking the inbound plane's tail number, and what broke along the way: 0,0 positions, flickering planes and Android battery optimisation.

linked_context.page_title: Your plane is somewhere else right now | Wheels Up
linked_context.page_description: How I predict flight delays by tracking the inbound plane's tail number, and what broke along the way: 0,0 positions, flickering planes and Android battery optimisation.
linked_context.page_excerpt:
I am 19 and I fly across 3 continents for 4 months in 1 week. Around 2 months ago, I tried to find a flight tracker to help me with this, however nothing was quite what I needed. Most of them were very pretty but lacked function, or vice versa.

If your flight is delayed, there's a good chance the delay started somewhere else. The plane flying your 6pm flight is going to be doing a lot of different flights in the morning. If there is any delay to any of its legs, there is a high chance you will be delayed.

In 2025, late-arriving aircraft caused about 40% of US delay minutes, more than any other cause ( US Bureau of Transportation Statistics ).

named_hotspots.name: OpenBot
named_hotspots.what_happened: CopilotKit团队在GitHub上开源了OpenBot项目，这是一个为AI智能体提供独立计算机环境的框架，允许每个AI“同事”拥有自己的浏览器、文件和工具，所有行动在执行前决策并在执行后记录。
named_hotspots.core_details: OpenBot是一个TypeScript开发的开源项目，旨在为任何AG-UI（自主图形用户界面）智能体提供完整的计算机操作环境。其核心特性包括：为每个AI智能体分配独立的虚拟计算机，集成浏览器、文件系统和工具；采用“决策-执行-记录”的工作流程，确保所有操作透明且可追溯；支持接入多种自主GUI智能体。项目由davidmckayv、kevin9327等开发者主导，目前GitHub总星标数达8172，单日新增247星，显示出较高的社区关注度。
named_hotspots.ai_take: OpenBot代表了AI智能体从单纯的任务执行向拥有完整操作环境的“数字员工”演进。通过提供标准化的计算机接口，它降低了智能体与真实世界交互（如网页浏览、文件处理）的开发门槛，可能加速通用人工智能（AGI）在自动化办公、辅助编程等场景的落地。其“先决策后执行”的机制也有助于提高AI行为的可控性和安全性。
